Why a fountain?

Cats are picky drinkers.
Still water is easy to ignore.

Many cats are naturally drawn to moving water. A bowl that sits all day collects dust, hair and food bits — so it often gets skipped.

The regular bowl

  • Water sits still and goes stale
  • Dust, hair and crumbs float on top
  • Needs refilling and rinsing constantly
  • Easy for your cat to walk past

The Paw & Co Flow Fountain

  • Water keeps circulating through the filter
  • Gentle streams catch your cat's attention
  • Clear tank shows when it's time to top up
  • Comes apart in seconds for a quick wash
Features

Thoughtfully designed for cats

How it works

Three steps to fresher water

1

Fill the clear tank

Add fresh tap or filtered water up to the top. The see-through body shows exactly how much is left.

2

Pre-filter catches debris

Water is drawn through the sponge pre-filter around the pump, trapping hair, crumbs and dust.

3

Flows from the flower

Filtered water rises through the stem and spills from the petals, circulating back into the tank.

✓

Rinse and repeat

Top up as needed and give it a quick rinse regularly. Replace the filter sponge when it looks worn.

FAQ

Questions? We've got answers.

How much water does it hold?

The tank holds about 1 liter (34 oz). Top it up whenever the clear tank shows the level getting low — for one cat that's typically every day or two.

How do I clean it?

Unplug it, lift off the top and flower spout, rinse the tank and the sponge pre-filter with warm water, then reassemble. We recommend a quick rinse every few days and a full clean weekly.

How often should I replace the filter?

Replace the sponge filter when it looks discolored or worn — usually every few weeks, depending on how many pets use the fountain.

Is it noisy?

The small pump runs quietly, and the main sound is the gentle trickle of water from the flower spout. Keeping the water topped up helps it stay quiet.

How is it powered?

It comes with a USB cable that plugs into any standard USB wall adapter or power bank.

Where do you ship and how long does it take?

Shipping is free on every order within the US. Delivery times are shown at checkout before you pay.

What if my cat doesn't like it?

Some cats need a few days to get used to something new. If it's still not a fit, you can return it within 14 days of delivery.
